searchText: Hey sorry <@504202741933932544> I'm a bit late to this, but just reading through the `BlobSidecarsByRoot` changes and have a minor question. I wonder if the wording below should be `MUST NOT` instead? because we only start serving blobs after gossip validation, so it shouldn't be possible to serve blobs that fails gossip validation? > Clients SHOULD NOT respond with sidecars related to blocks that fail gossip validation rules. The reason of the SHOULD NOT is that allows clients to serve those blobs without waiting the corresponding block to come in and gossip-validated MUST NOT implies that you cannot do that until you are 100% sure that the associated block passes the gossip rules. <@425572898787426305> am I correct in the explanation? <@504202741933932544> yes! <@466006586477772831> imagine the situation where the associated block isn't around yet, MUST NOT would restrict a node to serve sidecars only after the block has been received Just to be devil's advocate but the discussion in the issue is not really clear that we had decided to allow serving blobs without gossip validating the block. Perhaps it's better to make this explicit in the PR decription (there' s a mention of the MUST NOT issue, but when I tried to reply today to <@466006586477772831> directly I didn' t feel confident enough to point him to the PR). `Clients SHOULD include a sidecar in the response as soon as it passes the gossip validation rules.` I\We thought it was clear enough. Any suggestion on how to better clarify your point? It's fine in the PR, just meant in the description Ah yes, it might be a bit outdated. let me check it updated. Hopefully it's better now. Ah right got it, thanks all for the explanations and updating the PR description! It makes sense now 🙏

excerpts.author: jimmygchen
excerpts.content:
Hey sorry <@504202741933932544> I'm a bit late to this, but just reading through the `BlobSidecarsByRoot` changes and have a minor question. I wonder if the wording below should be `MUST NOT` instead? because we only start serving blobs after gossip validation, so it shouldn't be possible to serve blobs that fails gossip validation?
> Clients SHOULD NOT respond with sidecars related to blocks that fail gossip validation rules.

excerpts.author: tbenr
excerpts.content: The reason of the SHOULD NOT is that allows clients to serve those blobs without waiting the corresponding block to come in and gossip-validated

excerpts.author: tbenr
excerpts.content: MUST NOT implies that you cannot do that until you are 100% sure that the associated block passes the gossip rules.

excerpts.author: tbenr
excerpts.content: <@425572898787426305> am I correct in the explanation?

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content: <@504202741933932544> yes! <@466006586477772831> imagine the situation where the associated block isn't around yet, MUST NOT would restrict a node to serve sidecars only after the block has been received

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: Just to be devil's advocate but the discussion in the issue is not really clear that we had decided to allow serving blobs without gossip validating the block. Perhaps it's better to make this explicit in the PR decription (there' s a mention of the MUST NOT issue, but when I tried to reply today to <@466006586477772831> directly I didn' t feel confident enough to point him to the PR).
